title: Hamas Accuses Israel of Deliberately Trying to Wreck Gaza Ceasefire Deal
detail: Hamas publicly accused Israel on June 6, 2026 of deliberately attempting to wreck the Gaza ceasefire deal, further escalating the rhetorical breakdown in Phase 2 negotiations that have been stalled. The accusation deepens the impasse between the two sides as international mediators push for a path forward in the post-October 2025 ceasefire framework. Hamas characterized Israeli actions and demands as intentional sabotage of the negotiation process, signaling growing pessimism about Phase 2 prospects.

media.caption: Hamas accuses Israel of sabotaging Gaza ceasefire Phase 2 negotiations
